Description: Blue healer. High energy , needs work, great if you have land for him to protect.    Does jump, and strong. I

Name: Dice
Description: Meet Dice, a loving and loyal young pup with a heart as big as his playful spirit! This funny guy is a bundle of affection, always ready to snuggle up and shower you with love.   Poor guy was sick in the shelter. Outta the Cage rescued him in the nick of time, getting him to our vet to treat him for pneumonia. Thank goodness he made a full recovery! Dice now has all his vaccinations, is microchipped, and just needs his forever home.  Until then, our 2-year-old Staffie mix is now happily staying with trainer John. Dice is chill, social, and playful. He loves sunshine, easy walks, and quality time with his humans. He's ready for a new beginning.  Dice would thrive in a home with indoor-outdoor access and calm doggie friends. He is crate-trained and house-trained. While he gets along with dogs of all sizes, he was a little intense with a test cat.  Dice attaches very closely with his humans, so someone who is home a lot and can make Dice their best buddy would be the ideal adopter for him. Don't worry, he'll pay you back with kisses!  Dice is an all-around amazing dog who just wants to find his forever home and be your loyal sidekick. Could you be the one he's been waiting for? Come meet Dice and find out!  P.S.: Dice comes with a free training session and a crate!

Name: Quinn
Description: Quinn is a 1 year old Cattle Dog mix (with a dash of Border Collie, perhaps) who is friendly, playful, and absolutely full of heart. She is house- and crate-trained, loves her toys, and gets along beautifully with other dogs. After front-leg surgery, Quinn has bounced back with a full recovery and now walks and runs like the carefree young dog she was always meant to be.  Quinn will thrive in a home where she can be part of everyday life-hanging out with her people, joining in on adventures, and soaking up all the love. She is great with other dogs and kiddos; cats are unknown.  Please come meet Quinn and give this sweet, resilient girl the forever home she deserves.  Quinn is currently in foster in Reseda (a suburb of L.A.). Please reach out if you'd like to meet your new best friend and family dog!

Name: Valentina
Description: We met Valentina at the shelter after she was surrendered for 'no time.'  No time.  For an 8-year-old Staffordshire terrier who has done nothing but love her people her whole life.  When we met her, she looked at us with soft, hopeful eyes - and we simply couldn't believe it. A dog like Valentina doesn't need less time. She deserves more of it. More love. More comfort. More belonging.  She wasn't in the best shape when she arrived. There were lumps and bumps that had clearly been there a while, and a painful mouth that made it hard to smile. So we made a promise to her.  An outside vet removed her masses (all benign - thank goodness!) and gave her some much-needed dental relief, extracting five painful teeth. And you know what?  She feels better.  You can see it in the way she carries herself. In the gentle tail wag. In the way she leans into you and lets out that deep, contented sigh.  Valentina is not a high-octane dog. She is a steady, soulful companion.  She's lovely with calm dogs her size (no puppies or chaos for this lady - she's earned her peace). She bonds deeply with her people and will happily follow you around the yard while you plant spring flowers, keeping quiet watch like the devoted friend she is.  She's happiest on peaceful leash walks, lounging nearby, or enjoying a polite game of tennis ball. She prefers a calm environment and would thrive as an only dog or with a gentle canine companion who respects her space.  Valentina would be wonderful in a family with a relaxed lifestyle, or with older adults who simply want a loyal sidekick and warm presence in the home.  She lost her family once because someone didn't have 'time.'  Now she's looking for someone who understands that the best years of a dog's life aren't behind her - they're the ones spent feeling safe, cherished, and home.  Valentina has plenty of love left to give. She's just waiting for someone who has the time to receive it. ����

Name: Frisbee
Description: Meet Frisbee, a gentle and dignified young boy with an athletic build and a heart of gold. With his friendly and quiet nature, Frisbee is the perfect companion for those who enjoy the great outdoors. He loves nothing more than exploring nature, whether it's hiking through the woods or running alongside your bike.   Frisbee is a Panda German Shepherd (yes, it's a breed!). He's smart, always up for an adventure, and eager to please his humans. His gentle spirit and friendly demeanor will quickly win your heart. Come meet Frisbee today and take the first step towards a lifetime of adventures and memories with your new loyal companion!  Adoption application: https://outtathecage.org/apply

Name: Marzano
Description: Marzano may no longer be as petite as the tomato he was named after, but he's still just as sweet! This handsome 1 year old boy weighs about 55 pounds and is overflowing with friendliness, affection, and joy.  Marzano is confident, outgoing, and truly adores everyone he meets. He's never met a stranger, especially if they have treats! He loves making new friends, both human and canine, and does wonderfully with other dogs. He enjoys playtime with his dog buddies and is even a fan of dog parks, where his playful, social personality really shines.  He enjoys going for walks and is learning to walk more politely on leash as he continues his training. Marzano was raised around young children and has proven to be a gentle, loving companion with families.  Marzano would thrive in a home where someone is around often or with an adopter who understands mild separation anxiety as he continues to settle into his routine. He does well with his crate (some protesting at first) and benefits from consistency, reassurance, and structure.  If you're looking for a sweet, social, happy go lucky dog who will greet every day (and every person) with enthusiasm and love, Marzano is truly a very good boy ready to find his forever home.  Est DOB 1/12/25

Name: Zoey
Description: Meet Zoey!  Besides being almost unbearably cute, Zoey is a sweet girl who gets along well with other dogs and cats.  At 12-years old and 11-lbs, Zoey is a great walking partner who still has a lot of spunk. She rides nicely in the car and is housetrained. Her foster mom reports that she's super easy and well-behaved. Zoey has been fully vetted including bloodwork and x-rays. No dental was necessary because Zoey has no teeth.  Zoey is up-to-date on shots, spayed and microchipped.   Adoption process includes application, interview, home visit, contract and donation. If you are interested in Zoey, please go to our website at homeforeverylivingpet.org and fill out an application.   Los Angeles and surrounding area adoptions only.

Name: Theo
Description: Meet Theo!  He is a 65 lb neutered male, pitsky mix who is 5 yrs old. The perfect mix of calm and playful, this darling boy is being fostered by me after tragically losing his owner in a car accident. He checks all the boxes:  - Potty, leash, and crate trained - Gentle with kids - Great with other dogs (though he will love being the solo attention center!) - Beach lover and hiking buddy  Theo is that dog who wants to be a part of the action - whether it is a single person looking for their best friend or a family with kids who needs a playful shadow. He is affectionate, easygoing, and loves being where his people are.  Location: Irvine, CA but I can travel for meet and greets to LA and SD counties.  * Please only reach out if you/your partner work from home or spend little time outside the home. He deserves that!

Name: Leah
Description: Rescue Me's Photo upload isn't working so send an email and I'll see photos of Leah to you.Rescued a 4-year-old brown/white female corgi with an interesting tail (purebred though just tail never docked a la naturale) from the San Pedro Harbor Shelter on 2/20.  She was spayed on 2/21 and is in foster care with me.  She loves to play ball but must be low key for 14 days after her surgery, basically potty time.  She enjoys walks and has a good appetite.  She is current on all her shots and microchipped.  She would probably be okay with older kids 11 and up and has a medium energy level.  She needs an adopter that has a corgi background, will take her to training.  She is housebroken and likes balls and other toys.  She is crate trained as well.  If interested in meeting her, send me a pm.    I am looking for a home in the southbay area of Los Angeles or open to LA and OC counties as well.  Here are some shelter photos of her.  Her name is Leah and she did have a litter sometime back. She weighs 22 lbs.   Was an owner surrender at the shelter along with a french bulldog and a pug, all females.  Suspect this was a 'backyard breeder' but his landlord had issues and/or he was moving, not sure.  Adoption process.  First a meet/greet, then completion of a preadoption ap and a two-week trial period.  There is an adoption donation and a adoption contract.  Looking for a youthful adopter no older than 65.

Found this puppy near the I-10. I believe she was dumped. I have posted her online and have not received any hits, she does not have a microchip. She is a typical puppy who likes to play and is submissive and friendly with all my animals. I have too many so can't keep her. I believe she's a lab mix, and approximately 6 months old.

Name: Apollo
Description: Aggressive with other dogs and especially on leash.  Cannot be taken to a dog park.  Has bitten other dogs.  Needs an experienced owner ideally without children in the home.  I have seen him in training sessions and he wants to please but he needs someone who is experienced AND who has time to train.  Has serious potential to be a well-behaved dog with the right person and some TLC.

Description: Aggressive with other dogs and especially on leash.  Cannot be taken to a dog park.  Needs an experienced owner ideally without children in the home. Name: Otis
Description: Otis is about 2 1/2 years old, he is a whippet mix. Otis is the absolute sweetest boy in the entire world, his personality resembles a whippet perfectly. He gets zoomies and then wants to sleep and snuggle the rest of the day. Otis is the perfect work from home buddy that will curl up on your lap and snore until it's time for dinner. He is dog reactive but it can be trained through easily with good snacks. He is good with dogs with a very slow introduction, he comes off quite strong with new dogs since he wants to play immediately but not all dogs enjoy this. He doesnt bark very often and will snooze in his kennel while youre gone, as long as it's a quiet comfy spot. He really enjoys beds, pillows and will tuck himself into blankets. He does have a strong prey drive so cats may not be the best fit. He is a sensitive boy and will need a patient, kind family. He would also not do well in a dog park situation and is leash reactive to other animals, we've been working with him and he is a quick learner. Also being a whippet he does enjoy his sweaters.  Otis is about 30-35lbs. He does have a minor heart murmur but I've taken him to 2 vets and they've both agreed it's insignificant however, still something to look out for.

Name: Linda
Description: Linda ���%A4 1-Year-Old Doberman | Spayed | Vaccinated Adoption Fee: $375 Currently in a foster home in San Bernardino - READY TO GO HOME!  Linda is a one-year-old Doberman with a loyal heart and an incredible spirit. After being abandoned on a desert roadside - and running after the car that left her - she was rescued by a Good Samaritan. Since that day, she has shown nothing but love.  She is incredibly friendly and affectionate. Within minutes of meeting new people, she was already giving kisses. Linda bonds quickly and has that classic Doberman devotion - intelligent, athletic, and deeply connected to her humans.  She would thrive in an active home with a young, energetic adopter or couple who enjoys hiking, beach days, park adventures, and outdoor living. Linda needs structure, activity, and a secure backyard to stretch her long legs.  Home Requirements: �'ۢ Secure fencing required (she can clear a 5-ft fence) �'ۢ Best with large breed dogs �'ۢ Especially does well with male dogs �'ۢ Not recommended for small dogs  Linda is resilient, loving, and ready for a family who will never leave her behind again. Name: Nova
Description: Nova is a beautiful red Heeler mix with an incredibly loving heart and a gentle soul. She is house trained, though she may have occasional accidents as she continues to build confidence in new environments. Once she feels safe, Nova is deeply affectionate and forms strong bonds with her people, the kind of dog who loves with her whole heart.  Nova is still a bit shy and nervous, especially when meeting new people. She needs time, patience, and understanding to warm up, but with consistency and kindness, she slowly blossoms.  She can get a little car sick, so short trips and gradual exposure will be helpful as she continues to adjust. She lives with cats and does just fine, but on occasion will try to play chase, especially if they have their zoomies.  Nova would do best in a calm, patient home who can allow her confidence to grow. She is truly a wonderful dog for someone looking for a loyal, loving companion and who finds joy in helping a shy pup come out of her shell.  With the right home, Nova has the potential to become an incredibly devoted best friend.  Est DOB 8/5/25

Name: Cora
Description: Cora is a 1.5 year old sweetheart with a gentle, go with the flow personality. She may be a little shy at first, but once she's comfortable, she loves being around her people and soaking up all the love and attention they'll give.  At around 60 lbs, Cora is the perfect balance of playful and laid back. She enjoys a calm, loving home but also needs space to play, run, and explore before happily settling in for naps and lounge time. She bonds quickly with her people and thrives on companionship.  Cora does great with other dogs, is great with kids, and lives with cats (they're not her favorite, but she tolerates them). She's house trained, enjoys car rides, loves walks, and already knows sit, with plenty of potential to learn more.  With room to roam and people to love, Cora will be a loyal, happy companion ready to become part of a family.  Est DOB 6/24/24

Name: Mango
Description: Mango is an amazing, energetic Doberman with the sweetest heart and the friendliest personality. He truly loves everyone he meets and greets the world with a happy, gentle spirit. Mango is wonderful with other dogs and enjoys socializing, making him an easy fit for many homes.  He loves going for walks and is always excited for a car ride, adventures are definitely his thing. While he hasn't had formal obedience training yet, he's already getting started on basic training and is eager to learn. He's been reported to be crate trained, and his affectionate nature makes him a joy to have around.  Mango is the kind of dog who just wants to be part of your life, whether that's heading out for a stroll, riding along in the car, or simply being near his people. If you're looking for a loving, loyal companion with a big heart and an even bigger smile, Mango is truly something special. He would thrive having another buddy in the home to bounce around and play with!  Est DOB 7/2/25

Name: Drizzle
Description: Drizzle may have a soft and gentle name, but she brings a steady shower of sweetness wherever she goes. This happy little girl has that classic puppy mix of playful energy and affectionate cuddles. She loves romping around with her siblings, exploring new things, and then curling up for a cozy nap once she's tired herself out.  Drizzle is curious, loving, and eager to bond with her people. Like any young puppy, she'll thrive in a home committed to training, socialization, and helping her grow into a confident, well-rounded adult dog. She's ready to sprinkle your life with joy, laughter, and plenty of puppy kisses.  Est DOB 12/10/25

Name: Blizzard
Description: Blizzard might sound like a big storm, but he's truly a warm hearted, joyful pup. This sweet boy is full of playful energy and puppy curiosity. He enjoys chasing toys, wrestling with his littermates, and being part of the action.  After playtime, Blizzard is all about affection and being close to his people. He's eager to learn and will flourish in a home ready to guide him through puppyhood with patience, structure, and lots of love. Despite his frosty name, Blizzard is pure sunshine at heart and ready to melt into his forever family.  Est DOB 12/17/25

Name: Breezy
Description: Breezy lives up to her name in the best way: easygoing, happy, and a joy to be around. She's playful, affectionate, and loves being part of the action. Like any puppy, she enjoys zooming around with her siblings before settling in for sweet snuggles. Breezy will thrive in a home ready for puppy adventures, training, and lots of love.  Est DOB 12/17/25

Name: Jett
Description: Jett: 1 yr old black & rust male, neutered, undocked tail and uncropped ears. 13', 10 lb. Fully vetted.  This happy, fun-loving boy should more accurately be nicknamed JP for 'jetpack' given his lightning fast approach to life. He is wildly energetic (but in the good kind of way that only true Min Pin owners are all too familiar with). Jett is a black/rust male that is approximately a year old with natural ears and a tail. He gets compliments ALL THE TIME on his incredibly upright ears. He is currently 10 pounds but should put on an extra pound or two to be at his goal weight. No doubt he's burning calories faster than he's consuming them. Jett gets along with other dogs and would do best paired with another dog with similar vigor. Given his spirited personality, we feel he would thrive in a home with an active family and/or adopter. If there are children in the household, 10 years or older please that are dog-savvy. If you'd like to be considered as Jett's forever home, please submit an application using the following link: https://www.minpinrescue.org/home.html Note: Jett is located in Northern California and we will not fly him. He is available for adoption to California residents or possibly bordering states. The adopter selected for him must be willing to meet at or near his location. Note: Jett is located in the Sacramento area of CA - and we will not fly this boy. Description: Stormy is unlike his name... He is a bundle of joy with a bright, happy personality. He loves to play, interact, and soak up attention. Like any young pup, he'll need guidance and training, but he has all the makings of a wonderful lifelong companion. Stormy is ready to bring warmth and happiness into his forever home.  Est DOB 12/17/25

Name: Mila
Description: Mila is high energetic and very playful. She is 4 years old. She loves playing hide and seek with her tennis ball and sniffing it out and is one of the best catchers I've seen. She catches pop flies and line drivers no problem and rarely misses the catch. We are looking for someone who has time to provide her the playtime she deserves.

Name: Danish
Description: Danish is big, sensitive baby who just wants to be whispered sweet nothings and remind him that he is loved and that the world has better things to offer than when he first started before he came to us... He is a sweet boy who at the end of the day is full of puppy enthusiasm. He enjoys playing, discovering new things, and being part of the fun. He would thrive in a home with a family who can continuing boosting his confidence and taking him to explore the world. He's affectionate and eager to bond, making him a wonderful addition to a family ready for the adventure of raising a puppy.  Est DOB 12/10/25

Name: French Toast
Description: French Toast may be all black in color but on the inside she is golden, joyful, and full of personality. She's playful, affectionate, and eager to interact with her people. Like any young puppy, she's learning about the world and will benefit from consistent training and positive experiences. French Toast has all the makings of a loyal, happy family dog.  Est DOB 12/10/25

Name: Croissant
Description: Croissant is soft, sweet, and totally irresistible. He loves playtime and puppy adventures but also enjoys quiet moments close to his people. Croissant is ready to find a home that will continue building his confidence and helping him grow into a well rounded, loving adult dog.  Est DOB 12/10/25

Name: Pancake
Description: Pancake is as sweet as her name suggests. This playful little girl loves exploring, playing with her siblings, and soaking up affection from her people. She has that perfect puppy balance of zoomies and snuggles. Pancake will thrive in a home ready to continue her training, socialization, and give her all the love she deserves.  Est DOB 12/10/25

Name: Indy
Description: Indy is an 11 month old, 35 pound border collie mix that loves everyone she meets. She's searching for an ACTIVE family with a yard to run around and another dog friend. She gets along wonderfully with her canine foster sisters, but not so much with the feline ones. While Indy loves other dogs, she can be reactive to them while she's on a leash; barking to let you and them know she would like to go play with them ASAP! She's a fast learner, so will just need someone that is willing to work on leash training and this (playful) reactivity with her. She's already crate trained and potty trained! Indy also does great on car rides.  Given Indy's breed, her adopter must be committed to providing her with training, structure, physical exercise, and mental stimulation. She would thrive with a job to do and be great at sports like agility racing and dock diving. Indy is already a wonderful girl and has so much potential to blossom even further!

Name: Mochi
Description: Meet 4 month old Mochi! This poor adorable little monchichi was abandoned in a box in a park. She did not leave the box for three days as I kept seeing her post on the Ring app. None of the neighbors stepped up to help her so I sent one of our volunteers. She was shaking upon arrival. I gave her a bath and put her in with my pack and immediately a huge smile came on her face and she began playing. She is quite happy to be around other dogs and loves to wrestle. Even though she is the smallest she holds her own with the bigger dogs. She's been great with meeting people, great with kids, and she cuddles right next to you in bed. She is potty pad trained, but still too young to be spayed. We are just waiting for her first heat cycle and she can be placed into her foster to adopt trial. Two weeks after the heat cycle ends the rescue will cover her spay surgery.   She is so loving and affectionate and her misfortunate abandonment did not affect her personality. She stayed very sweet and trusting. She has scar tissue with her ear left ear like someone had slammed it into a door. The vet said it did not affect her hearing and it's not fixable and we'll just be a deformity. Her tail was also broken in 2 places, the vet said I could amputate but she's still wags it in excitement and it's just so cute that I don't want to amputate. It helps show when she's excited because she's very expressive with her tail. She's a very sweet dog who is lucky to be alive and her chapter is just starting. Please reach out if you would like to meet this little teddy bear.

Name: Pecas
Description: He's almost 2years old, Queensland Heeler/Mix and his name is Pecas  A little back story, he was a foster dog from the San Jacinto shelter. We thought we were doing a good deed as San Jacinto shelter posted dogs that needed a forever home or at least foster while they found a home for the pets. We decided to help out and reached out to them, and said we can foster while they find him a home. A few months go by and we reach out for any updates, no home yet. We reach out another few months, no updates. I tell them we have a female dog and can't have him anymore as we don't want puppies, they tell us they can't take him back yet or neuter him because that's only if we adopt him It's been close to a year! He gets our dog pregnant and I try to tell them again that they have to take him back. They tell me if I take him back they will euthanize him. A few more months go by and I decide to physically take him back and ended up adopting him (also got neutered) because they threatened that they were going to euthanize him as soon as I handed him over! Now we're moving to a smaller home and can't take him with us. I have been going door to door around the neighborhood to try and find him a home, no luck. So I'm posting him here hopefully we have better luck. We will take him back to the shelter he came from on 02/27/26 where it would be a 50/50 chance he will be ok or they euthanize him. We really tried finding him a home for months, unfortunately our efforts end in 3days. If interested please let me know thank you.

Name: Mocha
Description: This handsome boy is a loving, playful companion ready for his forever home. He enjoys daily walks and being outdoors, and he has great energy without being overwhelming. His absolute favorite thing is playing with toys - especially balls of any size! Fetch is his love language.  He is loyal, affectionate, and happiest when he's near his people. He would do great with an active individual or family who can give him regular exercise and playtime. After he's had his fun, he's content relaxing by your side.  If you're looking for a sweet, devoted dog who will keep you smiling and moving, this boy is ready to meet you!

Name: Maestro
Description: Meet Maestro! Yes you read that breed mix correctly a daschund rottie!!! He is the size of a doxie but the head and coloring of a rottie. He is a kind and playful little pup and does amazing in all social situations. He is 1.5 yrs old and loves people. He was abandoned by his family and such a velcro love bug. He needs help with leash walking as it's obvious he wasnt walked. You can tell he was loved as there are no signs of abuse and he is very trusting. He will be neutered soon and will need 1-3 weeks of crate training to help with being house broken. He ignores cats, gives kisses to all dogs.If you would like to meet this handsome boy pls reach out! He's being fostered in Claremont Ca

Name: Duke
Description: Duke is a 4 month old puppy who weighs about 18 pounds, and he is truly just the sweetest little soul.  His big ears and expressive face will melt your heart the second you meet him. He is incredibly affectionate and loves being around people and his sister. He is a total snuggle bug who will happily climb right into your lap for a nap, and when he is not cuddling, he is playing with his toys and just being a happy, goofy puppy.  Duke is already doing so well with crate training and potty training, and he is eager to learn and please. He has such a gentle, loving temperament and would make a beautiful addition to a family who is ready to continue guiding him as he grows.  When Duke first came to us, he was malnourished and had missing fur along his coat. Since being safe and cared for, he has been thriving. His fur is growing back, he is gaining healthy weight, and he is blossoming into the happy puppy he was always meant to be. He is expected to make a full recovery and is doing so incredibly well.  We love this boy so much. He is pure love, softness, and puppy joy all wrapped into one.

Name: Lola
Description: Lola is a 4 month old puppy who weighs about 13 pounds, and she is just as special as she is beautiful.  One look at Lola and she will steal your heart. Her striking green-gray eyes are absolutely mesmerizing, and her adorable Dobby ears are guaranteed to make you smile. She is incredibly sweet and loves spending time snuggling with her brother and her people. When she is not cuddled up, she enjoys playing with her toys and soaking in all the simple joys of being a puppy.  Lola is already doing very well with crate training and potty training, and she is eager to continue learning in a loving home. She has a gentle, affectionate nature and will thrive with a family who is ready to guide her as she grows.  When Lola first came to us, she was malnourished and had missing fur along her coat. Since being safe and cared for, she has been thriving. She is gaining healthy weight, her fur is growing back, and she is blossoming into a happy, healthy puppy. She is expected to make a full recovery and is doing incredibly well.  We love this girl so much. She is soft, sweet, and full of love.

Name: Danny
Description: Danny is a 13-pound bundle of love with the perfect mix of spunky and sweet! We believe he's a Chihuahua and Jack Russell Terrier mix, which would explain his playful energy and his big-hearted devotion to his people. This little guy loves to zoom around chasing toys and having a quick burst of fun. After about 10 minutes of playtime, he'll happily signal he's ready to recharge-by plopping right into his foster's lap to request ear scratches and belly rubs. It's his signature move, and it's absolutely adorable. Danny is very social and enjoys making new friends wherever he goes. He's generous with his doggy pals and gladly shares his toys-no resource guarding at all. He gets along wonderfully with other dogs of all sizes, and his foster believes he would do great with respectful children, too. When it's time to wind down, Danny settles into his crate with a few toys and sleeps soundly through the night. He has lovely manners to match his sweet personality. Danny does have a minor cherry eye that doesn't seem to bother him in the slightest. It's purely cosmetic, and an adopter could choose to have it corrected if they wish. If you're looking for a playful companion who will happily entertain you and then curl up in your lap for cuddles, Danny might just be your perfect match.

Name: Juliet
Description: Juliet is a petite sweetheart with a big love for her pack. This 8 lb, 1 year old tan-and-white cutie thrives around other dogs and truly wants to be where the gang is at-lounging, playing, or joining in on the fun. She's sweet, playful, and endlessly lovable once she feels comfortable. Juliet can be a little shy when meeting new people, but give her a moment and she blossoms into a social and affectionate companion. She's learned to walk nicely on leash, is fully house-trained, and does great with dogs of all sizes. (Smaller, younger dogs tend to be her best playmates.) She would likely want to play with dog-friendly cats as well. Juliet may be small, but she's happy to rough-and-tumble with her canine friends! Juliet isn't a huge fan of the crate, but she'll tolerate it if you're nearby-she much prefers hanging out with her people and furry friends. She is ready to find a home where she can be part of the crew. If you're looking for a dainty, playful pup who loves companionship and will happily join your pack, Juliet might just be your girl!

Name: Mabel
Description: Mabel is a 2 year old, female Blue Heeler from the streets of Victorville.  There was an enclave of dog in a junk yard. About 7 juveniles, lactating female and 11 nursing puppies.  They had all been saved, when Mabel also showed up.  All the pups were sent off to rescue in southern California with the nursing mom that had already been trapped, but now it looks like some of those puppies belong to Mabel.    Mabel is going to be ok. Hey pups are going to be ok. We're moving forward. Mabel is just like all the moms we get. Sweet as candy.  She appears to be a purebred blue heeler. Her tail was docked as a puppy. She's likely been on the streets for a while, but she's just the nicest, most unassuming girl.  Mabel apparently never learned what a leash was. And we're working on that now.  She's just a champ with other dogs. She let everyone give her the once over. And then she politely sniffed them one by one.  Mabel will be spayed as soon as her milk dries up. Then available for adoption. And we'd consider a foster to adopt situation. Let her get into her home and wait for her spay day.  More photos and updates:  https://www.facebook.com/www.cchdrescue.org/  search in posts and photo albums. Please complete an application at: http://bit.ly/CCHDR_App Note:  No transport or blind adoptions. Prospective adopters must have a plan in place to meet and pick up their dog from the foster location.

Description: Rambo is 9 years old, neutered, fully up to date on his shots, and has no medical issues. He's a friendly kitty who does well around kids and will warm up to other pets with time. He prefers being indoors now (though he was outdoor his first few years) and would thrive in a calm home where he can get the attention he deserves. With a 10-month-old at home and very busy work schedules, we aren't able to give Rambo the time and love he truly deserves. Our priority is finding him a safe, stable, and loving home. Name: Simba
Description: Simba - Adult Male Cat Looking for Experienced, Pet-Free Home  This is a very difficult post for me to make. I am currently pregnant and due very soon, and with my partner being in the military, I need to find Simba a new home before the baby arrives.  Simba came to me from a friend who told me he had his shots, but I do not have any paperwork or vet records for him, and I have not taken him to the vet since having him.  Simba is a very strong-personality cat and will need an experienced cat owner who understands cats with behavioral challenges. He must be the only pet in the home. He does not do well with other animals and can show aggression if he feels stressed, threatened, or overstimulated.  Simba has bitten through the skin in the past when he was overstimulated or frightened, so he needs an experienced owner who understands cat body language and can manage those situations calmly.  At the same time, Simba can be very sweet. He is talkative, enjoys attention on his terms, and does like to cuddle when he feels safe and comfortable. In the right environment, his affectionate side really comes out.  In a calm, quiet environment with someone patient and knowledgeable, Simba has the potential to do much better. He needs a home with: �'ۢ No other pets �'ۢ No small children �'ۢ Someone experienced with cats and willing to work with his behavior �'ۢ A calm, stable environment  This is not a situation where I am trying to 'get rid' of him. I care about him and want him placed with the right person who understands what they are taking on and is willing to give him the time and space he needs.  I am hoping to find him a home by the end of February / early March due to my pregnancy timeline.  A small rehoming fee will apply to ensure serious inquiries only.  If you feel you are a good fit, please reach out and tell me about your experience with cats and your home environment.  Thank you for reading.

Name: DESI
Description: This beautiful 7-year-old girl came to us after leaving an unsafe and abusive home, (literally abandoned in a contentions divorce), so she's understandably shy and cautious. She'll need a patient, gentle hand to help her feel safe and loved in her new surroundings.  She can be a little wary of men and new experiences at first, but once she trusts you, her sweet, affectionate personality truly shines. With people she bonds with, she loves to snuggle-sometimes even curling up under the covers for a cozy nap.  Right now, she hasn't been comfortable around other cats or dogs, so a quiet, calm home would be best. She's searching for a loving family willing to let her build confidence at her own pace. In return, she will offer unwavering affection and a truly special bond that's worth every moment of patience and care.

She is very affectionate and deserves attention and love.

Name: Sadie
Description: Sadie is a sweet, gentle girl with a cozy personality and a love for quiet companionship. At 10 years old, she's past the kitten chaos and enjoys peaceful routines, warm naps, and sharing space with her people. She's affectionate once settled and can be a real cuddle bug, especially when she gets to lay on your chest or perch on your shoulders while you're relaxing.  Sadie loves window watching, lounging up high in a cat condo, and claiming the coziest spots in the house.  She's in good health and spends much of her day napping, watching the world go by, and soaking up attention on her own terms! Sadie is litter-box trained (prefers it very clean), loves a scratcher, does well with kids and other pets, and will likely hide under the bed during loud moments like vacuuming.  If you're looking for a calm, comforting companion who forms meaningful bonds and enjoys quiet togetherness, Sadie could be a wonderful addition to your home.

She enjoys laying near her human at night on back of couch and getting gentle pets on her chipmunk cheeks. A sweet gal.she enjoys looking out window at birds and squirrels.

Name: Sadie
Description: Sadie is a 10-year-old long-haired cat (born July 2015) with a gentle, thoughtful personality. She's independent, low-maintenance, and happiest in a peaceful, low-key environment.  She enjoys doing her own thing and doesn't need constant attention, making her a wonderful companion for someone who values calm energy and quiet presence. She's affectionate on her own terms and can be such a sweetie once she feels comfortable-those moments of affection feel extra special because she chooses them.  She loves warm, cozy spaces like sunny windows, blankets, and heated throws, and will happily spend her days relaxing nearby. She can be shy around new people and loud environments, but thrives with patience, routine, and respect for her space.  She would do best in a calm home with someone who appreciates an independent cat with a soft, loving side and understands that trust takes time. In the right home, she'll be a peaceful, comforting presence and a truly special companion.

Name: Spud
Description: Meet your new bud, Spud! �ٴ����� Spud earned his name because, until recently, he lived outside in the dirt - just like a little potato! This adorable void quickly became a neighborhood favorite thanks to his friendly personality and gentle nature. Spud has FIV, which just means he'll do best as an only cat or with other calm, FIV-positive cats. FIV cats can live long, healthy lives indoors with good care and regular vet visits. He also has a mild heart murmur that's being checked out, but he currently shows no symptoms and feels great. Now that he's safe inside, Spud has shown what a sweetheart he truly is. He loves pets and attention, treats and scritches, and enjoys hanging out near his people. He's adapted beautifully to indoor life and is ready to find a calm, loving forever home. Spud approximately 2 years old. If you're looking for a sweet, loyal companion who's been through a lot and still has nothing but love to give, Spud might be your perfect match!   More of Spud:  https://photos.app.goo.gl/8j95bGcExHtz8GWt5

I am moving away and can't take him with me I want him to be in a loving home. He has a calm personality; he really will let you know if he needs something! Simon is an indoor cat; he is good with other animals. He just needs someone who will be patient with him. Simon is litter trained. When it comes to people and other animals, he can be very shy and anxious before he gets comfortable.

Name: Cheddar
Description: Cheddar is going to 16 years old this year and is such a sweet, loving boy. He just wants a person to cuddle with in his twilight years. He is talkative and silly, exactly what you would expect from an orange cat. He loves scratches on his cheeks, space heaters, camera bags, and screaming for wet food. He is a fairly tolerant cat when it comes to being messed with. He likes when you chant his name. He has been around children and crowds (holiday parties) and done well with both. He is a very  Cheddar was adopted by my mom and 1 from a family friend when he was ten weeks old in July 2010. My mom passed away in 2024 and a friend agreed to take Cheddar in. I wanted to keep him, but I already knew he didn't get along with my cat as she is very territorial. Recently, my friend reached out to let us know that while Cheddar was great with two of their cats, he did not get along with their third cat and they had started fighting. She asked for our help in finding him a better home.

Name: Noni
Description: I'm looking for a loving placement for my 10-year-old cat, Noni. She's sweet, gentle, and enjoys being outdoors.  A few years ago she was hit by a car and, as a result, is incontinent. She needs to be expressed daily and may leave stool around. Despite this, she's otherwise healthy, mobile, and very sweet. She especially loves being outdoors and relaxing in the sun.  I've recently accepted a job that requires me to move to San Francisco, and unfortunately I won't be able to bring her with me due to her special needs and my upcoming living situation. This has been an incredibly hard decision, and my priority is making sure she ends up somewhere safe and kind.  I believe she would do best in a quiet rural setting, farm, or sanctuary, ideally with someone experienced with special-needs animals or comfortable providing gentle daily care.  I'm happy to share vet records, photos, and help with transportation or initial costs if needed.  If you or someone you know is able to help, I would be deeply grateful. Name: ABIGAIL
Description: ADOPT A SENIOR LADY!  Abigail's journey has been a challenging one. Initially, her previous owner brought her to the vet to be euthanized :( But one of our local vets, saw the spark in her and reached out to us for help.  In her last home, Abigail had some difficulty interacting with her owner, so the owner thought euthanasia was the answer. Weird. Click below and see her arriving at our shelter:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9cEEDiw9UKA  In her previous environment, there were both a dog and another cat, and Abigail felt a bit out of sorts around them. We think she should be the only animal in a loving home!  Come down to the cat lounge and meet her. She was saved for a reason!

Name: PAN
Description: Pan (The Man) is an amazing 4-year-old neutered male Domestic Shorthair who has overcome so much. This sweet angel endured a terrible act of cruelty, abandoned on the roadside in the desert heat, confined in a small fabric carrier with only some M&M's for company. Understandably, he was quite reactive and scared due to his past trauma when he first came to us.  Fast forward three weeks, and Pan is now thriving, officially embracing his title as THE MAN. We adore this laid-back kitty! He loves to find the highest perches in our space, where he can snooze peacefully . Whenever we come to visit, he eagerly hops down, turns into a little chatterbox, and can't get enough of those head rubs!  Fast forward 2 months and PAN is in a foster home! Here is what his foster mom said last check in!  'I'm amazed by how loving and sweet Pan is even though he experienced severe trauma by the hands of humans. He's been friendly to anyone new who has come by the house and he even met my friends bigger dog and approached without fear, only friendly interest :) he loves to play, get pets and love, and really loves food and treats. He's a great kitty all around!'  Email :

Name: Sabrina
Description: Sabrina is a 5-year-old, 8.5-pound bundle of pure love. The moment you meet her, she starts purring and doesn't stop. She adores being close to her humans, rubbing against you for pets and curling up nearby just to be near you. She's the kind of cat who makes biscuits on her soft bed while gazing up at you with the sweetest eyes. Sabrina is playful and gentle, and she enjoys the company of other cats once she's had time to get to know them. She's more affectionate than most cats, truly a little cuddlebug who just wants to love and be loved. Whoever adopts Sabrina will gain a constant companion with the softest heart.

He enjoys being held for short snuggles, but his adventurous side soon takes over-he loves to run free, climb, and explore every agility course he can get his paws on.  If you're looking for a playful, affectionate companion who blends cuddles with endless entertainment, Hawk is ready to soar into your heart!

Description: Meet Charles Darwin!  You won't believe this, but sweet Charles has never had a home! This boy has spent his life at Save the Meow Meows! We brought him to us to get a fresh start!  With a calm and easygoing personality, Charles Darwin is like a keen observer, much like his namesake!  He's happiest in relaxed, cozy settings and gets along well with friendly feline buddies. His favorite activity? Watching the world go by from his comfy catio perch.  Though he might be a bit shy at first, a little patience and plenty of love will help Charles become the loving boy that he is!  Fun fact; Charles is a HUGE lover of Churu treats and catnip. Name: Kyle
Description: Meet Kyle - The gentlest little soul looking for his forever home. Kyle came to us as a stray about two years ago and he's been nothing but love ever since. He is an easy, sweet nature cat who does beautifully with adults and children. He's a little shy with men at first but he warms up quickly once he knows he's safe.  Kyle is happiest as an indoor/outdoor cat. He'll curl up inside with you, then politely wait by the door when he needs to go out. He uses a litter box if needed but he also has great outside manners and prefers having access to fresh air and a bit of roaming.  The only reason we're looking for a new home for him is because our older very dominant cat has never accepted him, and we're worried it may lead to a fight. Kyle deserves a peaceful home where he can relax, explore, and be part of the family. He's gentle, affectionate, and easy to care for. He just needs a loving home where he can be himself.  If you're looking for a sweet companion who will adore you quietly and faithfully, Kyle might be your guy.  I will travel outside of our area if needed to deliver him for the right home.

Name: CC
Description: CC was rescued from a large cat colony when she was about four months old. She's a beautiful and rare solid orange tabby girl (most orange tabbies are male) which makes her all the more special. Petite and sweet-natured, CC loves to be petted and is especially fond of belly rubs. Though she was shy and skittish at first, she has grown into a gentle and affectionate young lady with her foster mom. However, she's still shy with new people and places, so she would do best with someone who's patient and understanding as she adjusts to her new surroundings and people. Ideally, her adopter will have experience with cats, especially those who are on the shy side. CC gets along with other cats, though she may take a little time to warm up to them. With some love, time, and care, she'll become blossom into a wonderful and devoted companion for someone. CC CC craves attention from her human. She is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped. She's ready for her forever, loving home.

Name: Stacy
Description: Stacy was rescued from a very large colony when she was about four months old.  She was shy/skittish at first but has blossomed into a very sweet girl.  Stacy still is shy with new people and places, but once comfortable, she is loving and affectionate. She loves to be pet and roles over for tummy rubs.  She also will head butt you when she wants to be pet.  Since she is still shy with new people, she would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones, and will need some patience and understanding while adjusting to a new home and people.  She has one of the sweetest dispositions though and worth the initial effort.  Stacy is a striking tabico with soft white fur and delicate calico tabby markings, accented by distinctive black eyeliner around her eyes. She's gentle, mellow, and not at all dominant. Stacy gets along well with other cats and enjoys playing with her toys. One of her sweetest habits is gently sniffing noses before settling in close for pets. She's a lovely, tender soul looking for someone to help her shine. Stacy is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped.  She'll be a great addition to someone's home.

Name: Tattoo
Description: Tattoo was rescued from a large cat colony with his sister when he was about four months old. He was scared and skittish at the time, but since working with him he's warmed up and become a sweet boy. He is still shy with new people and places though and would therefore do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones.  Once comfortable though, Tattoo loves to be pet and play with the other foster kitties. He's a very handsome brown tabby with a soft looking face.  He'll take some understanding and patience while adjusting to a new home and people, but once comfortable he's a very good boy and would a great friend for someone. Tattoo is vaccinated, defleaed, dewormed, and microchipped.  He would love to be adopted with his sister or one of his other foster siblings, but he can also be adopted by himself to a loving home.

Name: Taboo
Description: Taboo was rescued from a large cat colony when she was about four months old. Although she was initially skittish and scared, she has blossomed into a sweet girl who enjoys being pet and even loves belly rubs. She gets along well with other cats and has fun playing with her foster siblings. Taboo is intelligent and gentle-natured, though not the dominant type. She can still be shy, especially in new environments or around unfamiliar people, so she would do best with someone experienced with cats, especially shy ones; she'll need someone with patience and understanding while she adjust to her new home and people. Once she feels comfortable though, her affectionate personality shines through. With time and care, she'll become a loving and loyal companion. Taboo is vaccinated, dewormed, treated for fleas, and microchipped.  She would love to be adopted with her brother Tattoo or another foster kitty from that came from the same place, but can also be adopted to a good home by herself.  Taboo will be a great friend for someone.

Name: Ginger
Description: Ginger was rescued along with her littermates from the river trail when she was a kitten. She was born a feral kitten and has since been socialized, but she is still shy/skittish with new people and places.  Ginger would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones. It takes time for her to trust new people and places, so she will need someone that is patient and understanding while she adjusts. Once she's comfortable though, she loves to be pet and is very playful.  Ginger might do best with a mellow male cat as a friend or as an only cat since she can be a bit alpha. She is vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. Ginger will make a great friend for someone once settled in, and be a fun addition to one's home.

Name: Hypatia
Description: Hypatia was rescued from a homeless encampment when she was a teenager and very pregnant.  Unfortunately, she ended up losing her babies and was then spayed.  I believe she was born in the encampment and was sleeping in a tent with a homeless woman, so she is shy and skittish and will take some time and work to warm up. Hypatia would do best with someone that is experienced with cat, especially shy/skittish ones.  With some time and effort, though, she'll be a good companion for someone who is patient and understanding with her while she adjusts.    Hypatia is a beautiful dilute tortoiseshell Maine Coon mix.  Her fur is fluffy in the winter, especially her tail, and she has the shorter legs of a Maine Coon.  Hypatia loves other cats and playing with her toys.  She is a sweet cat that can be a great friend for someone. Hypatia is spayed, vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped.  She's ready for her forever home.

Name: Mimosa
Description: Mimosa was rescued with her son Bradley when she was about 1 1/2 years old. They were from a feral/stray colony and skittish when rescued, but Mimosa and her son have become sweet kitties that love to be pet and play. Mimosa is still shy with new people, so she would do best with someone that is experienced with cats, especially shy ones, and patient and understanding while she adjusts to a new home and people. Once comfortable though, she'll be a great friend for someone. Mimosa is a beautiful dark tortoiseshell girl with a sweet disposition. She loves to be pet and play with her toy and gets along well with other cats. Mimosa would love to be adopted with her son Bradley, but can also be adopted by herself to a loving home. Mimosa is vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. She will be a great friend for someone

Name: Bindi
Description: Bindi is a sweet girl with a beautiful gray marble tabby and white coat. She was rescued with her sisters from under a freeway overpass. Bindi is shy around new people at first, so she would do best with someone who is experienced with cats, especially shy ones. Once she's comfortable and settled in though she's a real love bug. She likes to play with toys and be pet, but prefers not to be picked up. She is laid back and would do well in a quiet home with no children, and someone who will give her a lot of love. She would also do best as an only cat since she tends to just tolerate other cats. She might do ok with a mellow male cat though.  Bindi loves the catio her foster mom built! This allows her to enjoy the outdoors safely, while inside a large, enclosed area. Bindi is spayed, vaccinated, dewormed, defleaed, and microchipped. She'll make a great companion for someone.

Name: Ava
Description: Ava was rescued when she was about three months old. She was born on the streets from a stray mom. Right away I noticed something different about Ava. She had a strange looking tail. It was short, curled, and crooked. But she still wags it and her tail is very animated like a normal length tail. It looks like Ava was born with her tail like this. Since being rescued Ava has been in foster care. She was skittish and took a while to socialize, but is a spunky, playful girl now who loves to run around and play with toys. Ava is still shy with new people but loves to be pet and sits on her foster mom's laptop when the latter is working. Ava would do best with someone that is experienced with cat, especially shy ones, and one who is patient while she adjusts to her new home and people.  She's a funny girl with a lot of personality. Ava is spayed, dewormed, vaccinated, defleaed, and microchipped. She'll make a great friend for someone.

Name: GONZO
Description: Meet Gonzo!  Approx 1 year old, male neutered, Domestic Shorthair.  This handsome dude spent his entire life thus far at the Save the Meow Meows lounge. While he loves his Meow Meow family and they are equally obsessed with with, he's been consistently overlooked so he's joined the JT fam to get some fresh eyes!  This gentle boy is about to have a birthday; will he join your family just in time to celebrate?  He's a shy guy in our digs but he's a sweetie who just wants to be loved. He does well with various cat personalities but he prefers they be nice to him; swatting and hissing scares him into his hidey-holes.  Will work for Churu and catnip!

Name: BRAD KITT
Description: Meet Brad Kitt!  Approx 4 month old, male neutered, Domestic Medium hair.  Have you seen a jet black tabby?? You have now!  Not a common color pattern, this handsome gentleman (hence his namesake) is a black cat with stripes. Brad is a little on the shy side but that's just because he needs more socialization. He has done impeccably well with our other kittens and really likes to snuggle up to them. He doesn't like fast movements but he DOES love the magical kitty elixir that is Churu. He's one of those 'bites the package' to get more guys!

Name: Malina
Description: Malina is a gentle, mellow young tortoiseshell with striking butterscotch and black 'catwalk camouflage' and the sweetest, soulful dark round eyes. She enjoys the company of other cats, but cherishes quiet time curled up on a cat tree. Naturally shy and cautious, Malina warms up with patience and enjoys gentle petting. She'll often follow you, reaching out for more attention. She's happiest being near you rather than on your lap, and shows affection with soft purrs, quiet morning greetings, and gentle love blinks.

Name: Calypso
Description: Calypso is a talkative, friendly, spirited calico with bursts of playfulness followed by deep, cozy naps. She stretches and chirps to greet you, loves attention, and likes to follow you around, exploring and checking in on what you're doing. She's social and playful but sensitive, and may give a quick nip if overstimulated, so her people need to read her cues. Calypso has a big personality and could do well alone or with another easygoing cat. With her gold eyes, dramatic eyeliner, and clever, independent nature, she's entertaining and striking. With gentle guidance and a consistent routine, Calypso will bring colorful energy to your home.

Name: Fozzy Bear
Description: Fozzy Bear is a sweet, playful young muppet who alternates between zooming after toys and lounging in a sunny window. He enjoys the company of other friendly cats and even helps shy ones come out of their shell. Fozzy is a big boy and likes to be petted, but he's also quite shy and can be jumpy, always ready to dart away if unsure. A reassuring voice and gentle hand will help him relax. With patience, he will warm up and show his sweet side, offering soft kisses, graceful poses, and elegant tail swirls.
